  • Element Details

    • source

      Directory source
      Path to the directory containing the mock repository content.
      Returns:
      path to the mock repository source directory

    • cloneTo

      Directory cloneTo
      If set, the source() directory will be cloned to this path before the server starts. This is useful in case additional files are generated. Relative paths are resolved against the result of baseBathResolverm which defaults to the working directory.
      Returns:
      path to the clone target directory, or empty string to skip cloning
      Default:
      @org.codehaus.mojo.mrm.jupiter.Directory(value="", baseBathResolver=org.codehaus.mojo.mrm.jupiter.SourcePathResolver.class)

    • cloneClean

      boolean cloneClean
      When cloneTo() is set, controls whether the clone target directory is cleaned before copying. Defaults to false.
      Returns:
      true to clean the clone target before each run
      Default:
      false

    • lazyArchiver

      boolean lazyArchiver
      Controls whether directory content is archived lazily (on first access) or eagerly at startup. Defaults to true (lazy).
      Returns:
      true to archive directory content on demand
      Default:
      true

    • transformDirectiveSource

      Class<? extends TransformDirectiveSourceFactory> transformDirectiveSource
      Default:
      org.codehaus.mojo.mrm.jupiter.NoOpTransformDirectiveSourceFactory.class
